item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20261011)
item.description:
What's New

feat(dictionary): add selected text to personal dictionary via Services menu and global hotkey

  • macOS Services item "XKey: Thêm vào từ điển cá nhân" (localized en/vi/zh-Hans)

splits the selection into normalized words and adds them all

  • Configurable global hotkey (Settings → Advanced → Từ điển cá nhân) routes

through HostCommand.addSelectionToUserDictionary on both the local HID tap

and the remote/session callback; XKeyIM returns .unsupported so the event

reaches the main app

  • Shared UserDictionaryService pipeline for both entry points: extract,

normalize, dedup, batch insert (single write + tombstone clearing), confirm

alert for the hotkey path, centered HUD feedback

  • Best-effort re-enable of the Services entry in pbs NSServicesStatus at

launch (merges flags, preserves key_equivalent), plus a Settings hint and

"Open Keyboard Settings" shortcut

  • Bump CURRENTPROJECTVERSION to 20261011

Xem chi tiết trên GitHub
